name: Aanya Mehta
bio: Product designer who loves turning small everyday frustrations into thoughtful experiences. Weekends are for galleries, long walks and trying a new recipe.

name: Kabir Sethi
bio: A data analyst by day and an amateur cook by night. I like honest conversations, live music and getting outdoors whenever the weather cooperates.

name: Meera Iyer
bio: Researcher fascinated by people, languages and why cities feel different at different hours. Give me a bookshop and a good cup of coffee.

name: Arjun Rao
bio: Software engineer, weekend cyclist and enthusiastic playlist-maker. I appreciate a little adventure but value a calm, dependable home base too.

name: Sana Kapoor
bio: Brand strategist who finds inspiration in films, street food and conversations with people outside my bubble. Big fan of thoughtful effort.

name: Dev Malhotra
bio: Architect who sketches old buildings and searches for the best breakfast in every neighbourhood. Looking for someone warm and open-minded.

name: Ishita Bose
bio: Teacher, amateur potter and keeper of too many houseplants. I enjoy gentle humour, learning new skills and conversations that go somewhere.

name: Rohan Dutta
bio: Musician and UX researcher. I love finding patterns in both melodies and people, and I never say no to a spontaneous food walk.

name: Nisha Verma
bio: Doctor who protects her days off for trail walks, fiction and cooking for friends. I admire people who are considerate and direct.

name: Aditya Kulkarni
bio: Product manager who enjoys bouldering, board games and discovering lesser-known places on a map. I like clear communication and shared laughter.

name: Tara Shah
bio: Illustrator and weekend runner. My ideal plan involves a farmers market, a sketchbook and enough time to take the scenic route.

name: Neil Fernandes
bio: Chef who thinks the best meals happen when everybody helps. Outside the kitchen I am usually swimming, listening to jazz or planning a road trip.

name: Priya Nair
bio: Marine conservation volunteer who is happiest near the water. I enjoy science podcasts, quiet cafés and people who care about their communities.

name: Vikram Menon
bio: Civil engineer and weekend kayaker. I am practical, curious and always up for learning something I am not good at yet.

name: Zoya Ansari
bio: Writer who collects family recipes and stories about where they came from. I appreciate kindness, wit and people who ask thoughtful questions.

name: Rahul Srivastava
bio: Civil services aspirant who resets with badminton, history books and cooking something new. I value mutual respect and a good sense of humour.

name: Anika Sen
bio: Startup operator, amateur photographer and curious traveller. I like building things with people and making space for different points of view.

name: Sameer Reddy
bio: Video editor who loves cinema, running and finding music from unfamiliar places. I prefer sincerity over polished first impressions.

name: Leela Thomas
bio: Environmental engineer who spends weekends at the beach or volunteering for community clean-ups. I enjoy calm plans and big ideas.

name: Karthik Subramanian
bio: Audio engineer and vinyl collector who loves a long cycle ride and slow Sunday breakfasts. Music is my favourite way to connect.

name: Maya Bhatia
bio: Museum educator with a soft spot for textiles, forts and spontaneous road trips. I value learning together and cheering each other on.

name: Ibrahim Khan
bio: Landscape architect who loves old cities, long walks and cooking with seasonal produce. Thoughtfulness and reliability matter more than grand gestures.

name: Pooja Desai
bio: Finance professional, beginner salsa dancer and loyal board-game teammate. I love people who stay curious and do what they say.

name: Siddharth Jain
bio: Founder of a small social-impact venture. I read widely, play guitar badly-but-enthusiastically and enjoy meeting people who challenge my thinking.

name: Farah Qureshi
bio: Psychology graduate working in learning design. I enjoy theatre, meaningful volunteering and the kind of conversation that makes time disappear.
